english.title: Resume prohibited development involving winning, working and depositing of minerals
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without planning permission,

(A)_[resumed]_
(B)_[caused to be resumed]_
(C)_[permitted to be resumed]_

development

(D)_[consisting of the winning and working of minerals]_
(E)_[involving the depositing of mineral waste]_

the resumption of which an order under paragraph 3 of Schedule 9 to the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 had prohibited
english.legislation: Contrary to section 189(1)(b) and (3) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
